method: Synthetic independently namespaced copies of the 60 reachable EDA MyLang port modules. All copies called from root entry. Full CLI build wall time, prewarmed runtime/toolchain, fresh frontend/stage caches with previously populated native objects for cold_stages_warm_native; this is not a full cold-native build. Incremental edits retain caches and use unique new source/IR content each time. No release guest builds. At 32 copies optional extra phases change a common predicate consumed by every replica, and add a reachable predicate function in one replica. Shared-fixture baseline preparation is separate and excluded. Native seed copying, source generation, admission wait, and golden execution validation excluded.

12.reachability: All generated project modules reachable through imports from main; every replica called unconditionally.

32.reachability: All generated project modules reachable through imports from main; every replica called unconditionally.
